notes: Mirage Panel Editor is a guided stepper (CEO: "SO a stepper to go back and forth through the flow" / "no layers tab for Glamour either. Build it"): About, then 1 Position, 2 Layout, 3 Style, 4 Runes, 5 Configure in the tab bar, finished…

Layout step: every shipped layout as a picture drawn by the portal itself over the wallpaper (the one in use as it is, the others with their own saved look); the right side gives the number of cards, its size on this screen, where it sits…
Style step: the preview alone on the left; Background (the gradient only; Mirage has no solid) and Cards as collapsible groups, using the editor's own Gradient and Cards controls.

Runes step: click a card on the preview, then choose its Rune, its Look (only shapes that fit) and what it Shows, all as pictures drawn at the card's real size (panel-editor-tiles.html, the Content Designer's way). Configure step: a group…
Portal twin draws a whole layout for the editor (portal:preview-strip), fetches the portal's layers on every request, and reports each card's spec and padding.
